routes.listener: the product's internal address on this machine: OF_TEDER_INTERNAL (127.0.0.1:4700) or OF_TORAN_INTERNAL (127.0.0.1:4710)
routes.notes: Idempotent: a workspace the product never saw, or already deleted, answers 200 too. Any status but a 2xx stops the whole deletion, 404 included: a 404 is a product without the route, never "nothing there" (ACC-06). The body of a 200 is the product's own count of what it deleted; accounts reads only the status. accounts waits 10 seconds.

answers.case: nothing of that workspace here (never seen, or deleted already)
no such route: a failure, accounts deletes nothing
no token, or the wrong one
